We need to indicate number of C=O groups in the molecule. We have no SMILES given. We need to infer from data? Possibly we need to get IR spectra to see carbonyl stretch? Or carbon NMR? But we don't know molecule. Maybe the system expects us to request IR spectra which will show carbonyl peaks. But we need count. Could also use carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbons (~190-210 ppm). But we need to minimize cost. Perhaps we can retrieve carbon shift ranges to know typical carbonyl region, then get carbon NMR and count peaks in that region.

We have no other info. So we need to measure carbon NMR spectra. Use carbon_nmr_spectra tool. Then parse output to count peaks around 190-210 ppm. Let's do that.
